name: Messi Rewrites the World Cup Record Book
angle: The single biggest story of World Cup 2026: at his sixth and final tournament, Lionel Messi passed Miroslav Klose to become the men's all-time leading World Cup scorer, and passed Marta's overall mark of 17. Curated and de-duplicated from the daily World Cup quiz series (11 Jun to 2 Jul 2026).

questions.question: Lionel Messi scored a hat-trick as Argentina opened their 2026 World Cup campaign. What was the final score against Algeria?
Messi, the all-time leading goalscorer in men's World Cup history, captains which nation?
By taking the field against Algeria, Messi became the first man ever to appear at how many different World Cups?
Messi's milestone goal moved him clear of which Germany striker, the previous men's World Cup record scorer?
By the knockout stage of 2026, how many career World Cup goals did Messi have, a new men's record?
Messi broke the all-time record with a brace in a 2-0 group-stage win over which European side?
Before his record-breaking double against Austria, Messi missed an early chance to make the night even more emphatic. What happened?

options.B: He was shown a yellow card

questions.question: At 38, Messi became the oldest player ever to do what at a World Cup?

options.B: Captain a side in the final
options.D: Be named player of the match

questions.question: Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo made history in 2026 as the first players ever to do what?

options.A: Appear at six different World Cups
options.B: Score at six different World Cups
options.C: Captain a side at six World Cups

questions.question: Messi's tally also passed the overall World Cup goal record across the men's and women's tournaments. That mark of 17 was held by which player?
Midway through the group stage, who led the 2026 Golden Boot race with five goals, one clear of Mbappe and Haaland?
Messi arrived at the 2026 World Cup needing a strong run to reach the top. How many World Cup goals had he scored across all his previous tournaments combined?
Klose had set the previous men's record of 16 by surpassing a Brazilian striker who had scored 15. Who was that?
Messi's treble against Algeria made him both the youngest and oldest goalscorer in Argentina's World Cup history. In which tournament did an 18-year-old Messi score his first World Cup goal?
Messi's record run saw him score in how many consecutive World Cup matches, dating back to 2022?
